text_block_list.text:
Achoo! I can't believe she dropped me
into a waterfall...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Who would do such a thing? I'll personally
knock the snot out of that
dastardly
villain!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
You were so far ahead of us. What on
earth happened?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Sigh... It upsets me to even think of it, but...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Here's the chapel... This must be the finish
line.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oh my, my, my! You're the first to finish the race!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Me? But wasn't Mayano ahead of—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Never mind. If I'm the first to finish, that
means I can make my
proposal, correct?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Did you think that merely arriving
here the fastest would give
you the right
to propose?
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
A rigorous trial to overcome! The beauty
of a proposal made after
surviving it all!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
What matters is whether your journey
sparks my beauty sensors to
life! ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Although you are an exemplary student,
Эйр Грув, you are still
lacking oomph.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Crossing the finish line with such a cool expression won't generate any heat! You have to show me some fiery passion!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
So... you're saying I'm not worthy of be
your muse?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Hm... Let's just say you're not there yet!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Long ago, your mother showed my master
a beauty so wondrous, it
inspired them to
craft a special set of racewear for her.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
During my apprenticeship, they shared
your mother's story with me
while showing
off a photo of her wearing that racewear.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
She looked so powerful and dignified, and
she drew everyone's
attention just by
standing there.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
It was so beautiful... I made a solemn vow
then and there to one day
create racewear
just like the one your mother wore.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
But even though you're her daughter,
you're simply no good! You are
not fit for
me nor the racewear as you are now.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
I understand you are aiming to be the
Empress, but it seems you only
see your
racewear and this audition as mere
stepping stones on your
journey.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
And so, for you, my dear Эйр Грув...
Enjoooy! ☆ Here comes the
Beauty Aqua
Slide!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Wha?! The floor's—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Make sure to show me your true beauty
the next time we meet! ♪
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: UWAAAUGH!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It seems that "Aqua Slide" was connected
to this waterfall.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, what a shame! Even if you wanted
to take revenge, it's not like
you could
beat her up or anything!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Beat her up? No, I don't need to do that.
The next time we meet, I’m
going to make
her acknowledge me. That's how I'll exact
my revenge.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hm, so this is the cliff and signboard you
were talking about.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
"The road shall not open for those who
lack beauty." I suppose I
have... some
inkling as to what this means.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Really?!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what "beauty" is supposed to
mean in this case, but it's
probably saying
we need to climb this cliff.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's an entirely outrageous command, but if
that woman is the one who
put this here,
it's just par for the course.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: In that case, I'm going to climb up!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
If it helps me become a muse, I'll scale any
walls that stand in my way!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
This is what you meant when you were
talking about working toward
becoming
your ideal self, right, Kawakami?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Dober... Yes, that's right!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
I want to better myself, and I need that
racewear to gain the strength
to change!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't have confidence right now,
I've decided to stay
resolute and pour
everything I have into this!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Now all you need is
determination and guts!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'd better get started too. ♪
When it comes to dreams, no
one can beat
this strength of mine!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Hm... A strong resolution and the passion
to back it up... Those
certainly are
beautiful things.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
"The road shall not open for those who
lack beauty." ...There may be
a path for
me after all.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
(After talking to Ms. Beauty, the
admiration I held as a child toward
my
mother and her racewear has grown even
stronger...)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Even now, that admiration—these beautiful
feelings of mine—remains
in my heart.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I'm right behind you, Dober, Kawakami!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Now we're talking! ♪ Let's pummel Beauty
with all our hopes and
dreams once we
reach her at the top of the cliff!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
